events.title: Main Floors OST Original Soundtrack
events.summary: Captive 3000 features 108 tracks of sci-fi trance (36 per floor).The main floor music is generally upbeat, high energy psytrance, while the lower floors feature a darker, horror themed sound, and the upper floors feature uplifting choral and orchestral tracks.The main floor OST (Original Soundtrack) has been released on Steam today.Upper and lower floors will follow in a couple of weeks.
